notes: Successor to the Alaska Airlines Visa Signature (Mileage Plan became Atmos Rewards, points not miles); sibling tiers are the Atmos Rewards Summit Visa Infinite and Atmos Rewards Visa Business; Alaska's terms page still carries the legacy 'Alaska Airlines Visa Signature' title, so legacy cards appear to run on these same terms.

entitlements.name: Annual $99 Companion Fare
entitlements.limits: Earned only after $6,000+ net purchases in the anniversary year; code arrives within 2 billing cycles of the anniversary. You pay $99 base fare plus taxes/fees from $23 (from $122). Coach only, round-trip or one-way, no multiple stopovers, Alaska/Hawaiian-operated flights within North America incl. Hawaii. Companion must be on a paid published coach fare booked together; both fares charged to the primary cardholder's card. Not valid with award travel or other discounts. Must be booked within 12 months of issue (travel may be later); no extensions.
entitlements.source_excerpt: The Companion Fare code must be redeemed within 12 months of the date of issue. Once ticketed, travel may be completed after the expiration date of the Companion Fare code.

entitlements.name: Free first checked bag (cardholder + 6 guests)
entitlements.limits: 1 free bag each for any cardholder and up to 6 guests on the same reservation; flights marketed by Alaska and operated by Alaska, Horizon or SkyWest only (no other-carrier codeshares). Primary cardholder must be an Atmos Rewards member. Not retroactive; active about 2-3 weeks after account opening. Issuer says up to $90 per person round trip.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Any cardholder who has an open account at the time of travel and up to 6 guests traveling on the same reservation may check 1 bag free of charge on qualifying reservations.

entitlements.name: Preferred boarding (cardholder + 6 guests)
entitlements.limits: Airfare must be bought with the card and the primary cardholder's Atmos Rewards number must be on the reservation; Alaska-marketed flights operated by Alaska, Horizon or SkyWest; boards after status holders, premium cabins and pre-board groups.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Airfare must be purchased with your Atmos™ Rewards Visa® credit card to qualify for this benefit. To receive priority boarding, the primary cardholder's Atmos Rewards number must be included

entitlements.name: 3x on Alaska and Hawaiian Airlines purchases
entitlements.limits: No cap. Purchases through third parties (travel agencies, online merchants) do not earn 3x.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Otherwise eligible Alaska Airlines Purchases made through a third-party merchant (e.g., travel agency, online merchant) will not earn 3 points per dollar.

entitlements.name: 2x on gas, EV charging, cable/streaming, local transit
entitlements.limits: No cap. Based on merchant category code; the bank does not control how a merchant is coded.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Earn 2 points for every $1 of eligible Gas/Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Station, Cable and Select Streaming Service and Local Transit (including Ride Share) Net Purchases.

entitlements.name: 1x on everything else
entitlements.limits: Balance transfers, cash advances, fees and interest earn nothing. Points do not expire on active accounts.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Earn 1 point for every $1 of Net Purchases charged to the card each billing cycle.

entitlements.name: 10% points bonus with a Bank of America account
entitlements.limits: Needs an open consumer Bank of America checking/savings or Merrill investment account meeting the balance/activity test; can take up to 60 days after opening that account to start.
entitlements.source_excerpt: If the primary cardholder or joint cardholder (excluding authorized users) has a Qualifying Account with us, a 10% bonus will be added to the points earned

entitlements.name: 1 status point per $3 spent
entitlements.limits: Atmos Rewards status points (count toward elite status, not redeemable points). Issuer FAQ says no cap on earning.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Cardholders earn one status point for every $3 spent on purchases, with no cap on earning.

entitlements.name: 20% back on in-flight purchases
entitlements.limits: Paid as a statement credit within 7 days of posting; account must be open and in good standing. No stated cap.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Cardholders will receive a 20% rebate, in the form of a statement credit, for purchases of food, beverages, and Wi-Fi onboard Alaska and Alaska operated flights

entitlements.name: $100 off Alaska Lounge+ membership
entitlements.limits: Applies to an annual Lounge+ membership bought with the card; not combinable with other Lounge+ discounts; memberships non-refundable. Value only counts if you buy a membership.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Cardholders will receive $100 off an annual Alaska Lounge+ Membership purchased with their Atmos™ Rewards Visa® credit card.

entitlements.name: Welcome bonus: 50,000 points + $99 Companion Fare
entitlements.limits: Spend $1,500+ in purchases within 90 days of opening. Online-only, limited-time; offer amounts change often (third-party sites show other versions).
entitlements.source_excerpt: *After spending $1,500 or more on purchases within the first 90 days after account opening. This online only offer may not be available elsewhere if you leave this page.

entitlements.name: Atmos Rewards Dining (auto-enrolled)
entitlements.limits: Card is enrolled automatically; extra 1 point per $2 at participating restaurants only, on top of card earn. Run by Rewards Network.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Your card will be automatically enrolled in Atmos™ Rewards Dining... You'll earn 1 point for every $2 spent at participating restaurants.

entitlements.name: No foreign transaction fee
entitlements.source_excerpt: The Foreign Transaction Fee is 0% of the U.S. dollar amount of each transaction made in a foreign currency.

entitlements.name: $0 Liability Guarantee
entitlements.limits: Covers fraudulent transactions; you must not have shared your personal or account information.

entitlements.name: Auto rental collision damage waiver
entitlements.limits: Visa Signature benefit; primary vs secondary and exclusions not confirmed. Check the cardholder Guide to Benefits (in online banking under Statements & Documents).
entitlements.source_excerpt: Not listed on issuer product page; reported by third-party reviews.

entitlements.name: Lost luggage reimbursement
entitlements.limits: Limits and conditions not confirmed; check the cardholder Guide to Benefits.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Not listed on issuer product page; reported by third-party reviews.

entitlements.name: Purchase protection and extended warranty
entitlements.limits: Only one third-party source lists these for this card; terms unknown. Check the cardholder Guide to Benefits.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Not listed on issuer product page; reported by one third-party review.
